meta.name: kevstig coverage snapshot (KA-002, routed slice)
meta.provenance: Real API data; FULL ROUTED slice (298 of the API's 298 routed entries) built from the repo's own kevstig.py deploy run of 2026-10-05 15:02 UTC (complete body; the earlier torn 750KB-fetch-spill slice of 156 rows is superseded - it stopped before 2021-era rows and hid the one DB-known CVE). Counts stay the live numbers; the entries = the decoded routed rows verbatim; feeds the KA-029 expansion queue. Public data only.

entries.description: Microsoft Windows DNS Servers fail to properly handle requests, allowing an attacker to perform remote code execution in the context of the Local System Account. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of SIGRed.
entries.note: Reference CISA's ED 20-03 (https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/ed-20-03-mitigate-windows-dns-server-remote-code-execution-vulnerability-july-2020-patch-tuesday) for further guidance and requirements. Note: The due date for addressing this vulnerability aligns with the requirements outlined in ED 20-03. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2020-1350

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: Microsoft Windows contains an unspecified vulnerability due to the way ws2ifsl.sys (Winsock) handles objects in memory, allowing for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Privilege Common Log File System (CLFS) Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver improperly handles objects in memory which can allow for privilege escalation.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting (WER) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting (WER) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the way it handles files, allowing for code execution in kernel mode.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

entries.name: Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Use-After-Free Vulnerability
entries.description: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a race condition vulnerability when running the nsDocShell destructor under certain conditions. The race condition creates a use-after-free vulnerability, causing unspecified impacts.

entries.name: Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Use-After-Free Vulnerability
entries.description: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a race condition vulnerability when handling a ReadableStream under certain conditions. The race condition creates a use-after-free vulnerability, causing unspecified impacts.

entries.name: Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Type Confusion Vulnerability
entries.description: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a type confusion vulnerability due to incorrect alias information in the IonMonkey JIT compiler when setting array elements.

entries.name: Nagios XI Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
entries.description: Nagios XI contains a remote code execution vulnerability in which a user can modify the check_plugin executable and insert malicious commands to execute as root.

entries.name: VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS OpenSLP Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability

entries.name: VMware ESXi OpenSLP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
entries.description: VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

entries.name: VMware vCenter Server File Upload Vulnerability
entries.description: VMware vCenter Server contains a file upload vulnerability in the Analytics service that allows a user with network access to port 443 to execute code.

entries.name: VMware vCenter Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
entries.description: VMware vSphere Client contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Virtual SAN Health Check plug-in, which is enabled by default in vCenter Server, which allows for remote code execution.
